description: TEST FIXTURE ONLY - never registered in production. A minimal registry member that exists so engine claims with NO shipped subject still have a real component to name. Its slot map and recipes were deleted at #1101 with the style-slot engine; what remains is the shape a claim needs when the thing it protects is a prop the shipped registry happens not to declare. See tests/fixtures/components/ppfixture/README.md for the hosted claims and the death condition.

id.description: Stable band id, so the fixture behaves like any other band at the write path.

title.description: A heading, so the fixture renders something when the hosted claims need a band on the page.

theme.description: A tone prop, so the fixture emits its theme class through pp_theme_class() the way a shipped band does.

background_image.description: THE HOSTED CLAIM (#705). Declares `format: image_url` because the registry invariant requires every canonical image-shaped prop to (ActionsTest::testEveryImageShapedSchemaPropDeclaresImageUrlFormat) - a fixture that broke a registry invariant would fail the very suites it hosts. Kept as a TEXT url rather than an attachment id on purpose: the guard under test is the raw-value check that has to run BEFORE a typed escaper, and a url-shaped string prop is the shape that reaches it.

items.description: Makes the component composable (every composable component must declare a required prop - SchemaValidationTest pins that invariant). Carries no `item_fields`: that key was declared here and read by no engine code, and it was deleted at #1101 with the rest of the inert vocabulary.
